Blackbird Interactive is looking for an experienced Senior Level Designer to help build and deliver high-quality gameplay spaces for an action RPG focused on fast-paced combat, character progression, exploration, and replayability. This role focuses on designing levels, encounters, and environments that create satisfying combat opportunities, reward exploration, and support a wide variety of player builds and abilities.

You'll work closely with systems design, combat design, art, narrative, audio, and engineering to create spaces that complement the game's core combat systems while providing strong pacing, readability, and a sense of discovery. The role involves collaborating with leadership to align content with the overall creative vision while owning levels end-to-end, from initial layout and blockout through implementation, iteration, and polish. As a senior designer, you'll be expected to independently solve complex level design problems, provide strong design judgment, and help establish a high quality bar for playable content across the game.

\n


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with combat, systems, narrative, art, engineering, audio, and production to create levels that support the established creative vision and core gameplay pillars

  • Own levels end-to-end, including layouts, blockouts, combat spaces, encounters, traversal, exploration, pacing, and player flow

  • Design engaging combat spaces that support varied enemies, character builds, abilities, positioning, and different approaches to combat

  • Create rewarding exploration through optional paths, secrets, environmental storytelling, and meaningful rewards while maintaining clear navigation and progression

  • Script and implement gameplay events, encounters, objectives, triggers, and environmental interactions directly in engine

  • Test, debug, and iterate on levels using playtest feedback to improve combat flow, difficulty, pacing, readability, and replayability


Requirements

  • A minimum of 8 years of game development experience, with significant experience designing and implementing levels for action, RPG, or combat focused games

  • Experience shipping multiple titles, including at least one in a senior or equivalent level design role

  • Proven ability to independently own complex levels from initial concept and blockout through implementation, iteration, and final polish

  • Strong understanding of action RPG level design, including combat spaces, encounter pacing, exploration, progression, player guidance, and replayability

  • Strong hands-on experience with level editing, gameplay scripting, and in-engine implementation, with the ability to prototype, debug, and iterate quickly

  • Strong design judgment, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to balance gameplay quality, creative goals, technical constraints, and production realities


Pluses

  • Passion for action RPGs centered on combat, character builds, loot, progression, and exploration

  • Experience designing levels for an isometric or elevated gameplay camera, with an understanding of its impact on combat readability, navigation, and composition

  • Experience creating replayable content that supports different character builds, abilities, difficulty levels, or repeated playthroughs

  • Appreciation for systemic combat and how level geometry, enemy composition, hazards, and interactive elements combine to create varied encounters

  • Experience designing dungeons, interconnected environments, procedural or modular level content, or other repeatable gameplay spaces

  • Strong instincts for environmental storytelling, gameplay readability, polish, and identifying opportunities to improve the player experience through iteration

1KOMMA5°

At 1KOMMA5°, we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it?

We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia.

Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow.

Learn about our Product & Tech team!

Deine Position

As a Working Student in AI Process & Business Excellence, you will look at how work actually gets done at 1KOMMA5°, and then make it faster, cheaper and less manual. You will sit inside the Employee Technology team and work directly with the business functions that run our operations: Sales, Service, Finance, People and the country markets.

Your job is not only to write documentation about processes. Your job is to talk, understand, and identify opportunities throughout the organisation. Those opportunities are then aligned with the team, and an approach is taken to ensure delivery - quantifying the waste, and building or specifying the automation that removes it, using AI tooling and our existing automation platforms. You will be trusted with real processes and real stakeholders from your first weeks.

The average day of a Working Student in AI & Business Process Automation

The role is divided into 3 key value areas

  1. Process analysis: Mapping and reviewing existing business processes across our markets. You run user interviews with the people doing the work, document the current state, and measure cycle times, handoffs and manual touchpoints. You also look at job titles across the organisation and benchmark them against the market, to understand how those roles have been optimised elsewhere and what that means for us. You will be expected to bring numbers, not opinions.
  2. Automation delivery: Delivering the improvements you have identified, together with the team. Smaller cases you build in-house using our existing toolset (n8n, Google Workspace / AppScript, APIs and our AI tooling). On more complex processes you work alongside experts in the team, learning how larger automations are scoped, specified and delivered. You test what you build and you measure whether it actually saved anything.
  3. AI enablement: Educating colleagues on quick wins and small changes they can make to their own workflow. Not everything needs to be process automation, sometimes it just needs a slight change in user behaviour, and knowing the difference is part of the job. You will run short enablement sessions, build and refine prompts and internal AI assistants for specific teams, feed back where people struggle so we can improve the tooling, and contribute to our broader AI enablement initiatives across the employee base.

Dein Profil

  • You are enrolled at a university for the entire duration of the working student contract, in Industrial Engineering (Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen), Business Informatics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Administration with a technical focus, or a comparable field

  • Structured, self-directed working style. You are given problems, not tickets, and you organise yourself accordingly

title: Senior RF Engineer II
description:
At CesiumAstro, we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team.

We are looking to add a Senior RF Hardware Engineer to our team. If you are great at what you do, enjoy working in a startup environment, and are passionate about developing leading-edge electronics for satellites, spacecraft, and aerospace systems, we would like to hear from you. 

At the Senior II level, you will be tasked with full-stack hardware development for complex modules and small systems. You will have the opportunity to start at concept development and progress through detailed design, analysis, layout, build, test, and delivery, doing hands-on work at each phase. The Senior II level also introduces technical leadership opportunities, gaining responsibility for small teams of hardware engineers developing new products and systems. 

 At a small company and a startup, your work will make direct contributions to the success of the business. The work is challenging and impactful, requiring both breadth and depth of technical knowledge. Our products are made for high-reliability space and airborne applications, so designs require high levels of technical rigor while maintaining the agility of a startup environment.  

 The successful candidate will also present engineering design review materials to our customers and executive team. As such, excellent written and verbal communication skills are required. 


SUMMARY OF RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Design and develop RF, mixed-signal, and digital hardware for electronically steered antenna (AESA) communication systems.
  • Support the adaptation of existing hardware designs for new customer platforms, operational environments, and regional requirements.
  • Develop RF front-end, power distribution, control, and interface circuitry for phased-array communication terminals.
  • Own the development of hardware modules and subsystems from requirements through schematic capture, layout, integration, verification, and production release.
  • Develop hardware requirements, perform trade studies, and support subsystem architecture development.
  • Perform detailed schematic design for complex RF, mixed-signal, and high-speed digital circuit boards.
  • Support PCB layout activities in Altium Designer, including stack-up definition, component placement, routing reviews, and design-for-manufacturing considerations.
  • Perform engineering analyses including worst-case circuit analysis, signal integrity, power integrity, thermal, and reliability assessments.
  • Develop and execute hardware bring-up, integration, debugging, and design verification activities.
  • Support RF characterization, system integration, troubleshooting, and root-cause investigations using laboratory test equipment.
  • Define and execute environmental, qualification, and compliance testing activities, including EMI/EMC verification.
  • Collaborate closely with all the relevant engineering teams throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Support technical design reviews, engineering documentation, requirements traceability, and customer-facing technical activities.
  • Contribute to product qualification, certification, manufacturing transfer, and production support activities.
  • Provide technical support for field trials, demonstrations, customer evaluations, and deployment activities.
  • Mentor junior engineers and technicians while promoting engineering best practices and technical rigor.
  • Apply knowledge of adjacent disciplines, including software, systems, RF, and mechanical engineering, to support efficient product development and integration.

    • JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
  • Bachelor of Science (BS) degree or higher in Electrical Engineering from an accredited university.
  • Minimum of 6 years of relevant experience in board-level electronics design, analysis, and test.
  • Direct experience designing high-reliability electronics for space or defense applications, including part derating, worst-case analysis, and thermal constraints.
  • Experience owning the design phase of complex board-level electronics, including trade studies, key part selection, and detailed design.
  • Experience delivering hardware designs through production and deployment.
  • Expertise in PCB layout, including high-density interconnect (HDI) stackup design and high-speed routing.
  • Experience running board-level signal integrity and/or power integrity simulation tools such as Ansys SIwave, ADS SIPro, or Mentor Hyperlynx.
  • Strong working knowledge of adjacent fields, such as software and mechanical, that guides hardware design and system design
  • Expert-level proficiency in electronics design tools such as Altium.
  • Extensive lab experience for bring-up and verification of new hardware.
  • Excellent written and spoken communication skills.

    • WHAT WE OFFER
  • Experience leading small teams of hardware engineers to develop multi-module assemblies, including hardware architecture, requirements, make/buy decisions, and interconnects.
  • Design for space radiation environments
    • CesiumAstro considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, education/training, and key skills.

    Please be aware that many roles will be subject to both security and export control restrictions. These restrictions mean that factors including new starter’s nationality, any previous or dual nationalities held, place of birth and country of residence may limit those roles that you can perform for the organization.

    Please note: CesiumAstro does not accept unsolicited resumes from contract agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited resumes submitted to our website or to CesiumAstro team members not through our approved vendor list or Talent Acquisition will be considered property of CesiumAstro, and we will not be obligated to pay any referral fees.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Python & TypeScript, Microservices & Data Pipelines)
description:
EquiMatch is an AI-powered M&A origination platform connecting private equity firms, search funds, corporate development teams, and M&A advisors with acquisition targets. Behind the product is a data-heavy platform: web crawlers, LLM-driven company analyzers, scoring pipelines, a unified mailbox service, and CRM integrations — orchestrated across dozens of Python and Node.js microservices.
We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer who is strong in Python, solid in TypeScript, and used to owning distributed systems in production. You’ll split your time between Python services and pipelines and TypeScript services built on Encore, and you’ll be expected to set technical direction, not just execute on it. We value engineers who use AI daily to move faster and build better.

Tasks

  • Design, build, and operate Python and Node.js (TypeScript/Encore) microservices: define service boundaries, APIs, data flows, and integrations.
  • Build and maintain data pipelines — crawling, enrichment, company analysis, scoring — orchestrated with Prefect.
  • Model data and optimize queries on PostgreSQL (schema design, migrations, indexing, query performance).
  • Work with asynchronous messaging (NSQ) and background job queues to build resilient, idempotent processing.
  • Integrate LLM APIs into production workflows (extraction, classification, summarization) and make them reliable, observable, and cost-efficient.
  • Own features end-to-end: requirements, technical design, implementation, testing, deployment on Railway, and monitoring.
  • Improve observability and performance across services and LLM calls: tracing, metrics, slow-query analysis, failure-rate monitoring.
  • Drive architecture decisions, write technical designs, and mentor other engineers through reviews and pairing.
  • Contribute to automation (n8n) and internal tooling where needed.

Requirements

  • 6+ years of professional backend experience, with at least 4 years of Python in production.
  • 2+ years of professional TypeScript/Node.js experience building backend services (Encore, NestJS, Fastify, Express, or similar).
  • Deep experience with modern Python tooling: async/await, type hints, FastAPI or similar, Pydantic, pytest.
  • Strong command of microservice architecture: service decomposition, API design, resiliency, idempotency, observability.
  • Production experience with PostgreSQL — schema design, migrations, query optimization.
  • Experience with message queues or workflow orchestration (Prefect, Celery, NSQ, RabbitMQ, Kafka, or similar).
  • Track record of owning systems end-to-end in production, including incidents and performance work.
  • Habitual use of AI tools in day-to-day development; ability to apply AI effectively (prompting strategies, code/test generation, agentic workflows).
  • Clear communication, ownership mindset, and a bias toward shipping.

Nice to have

  • Encore experience specifically.
  • Web scraping and crawling at scale: rate limiting, proxies, anti-bot handling, content extraction.
  • Building products on LLM APIs: structured outputs, evaluation, prompt versioning, cost/latency tuning, MCP servers.
  • LLM observability and evaluation tooling (LangWatch, Arize Phoenix, or similar).
  • Observability stacks (Grafana, Tempo, OpenTelemetry).
  • Analytics tooling (PostHog, ClickHouse).
  • Docker and cloud deployment (Railway, AWS, GCP); Infrastructure as Code basics.
  • Security best practices (OWASP, OAuth2/JWT, secrets management, GDPR-aware data handling).
  • Experience with email/CRM integrations (IMAP, Gmail API, Microsoft Graph, HubSpot/Zoho).
  • Familiarity with the M&A, private equity, or B2B data space.

Our stack

  • Backend: Python microservices, Encore (TypeScript/Node.js) services
  • Orchestration & messaging: Prefect, NSQ, background job queues, n8n
  • Data: PostgreSQL, ClickHouse (analytics)
  • Infrastructure: Railway, Docker, GitHub Actions
  • Observability: Grafana, Tempo, LangWatch, Arize Phoenix (LLM tracing & evaluation)
  • Analytics & tooling: PostHog, Linear, internal skills/MCP system
  • AI: LLM-assisted development workflows, LLM APIs in production, MCP integrations

Benefits

  • Meaningful ownership of core systems in a small, senior team
  • Direct impact on a product used by PE firms and M&A professionals
  • Support for AI-enhanced workflows and tooling
  • Budget for learning, conferences, and hardware
  • Flexible hours and remote-friendly culture

title: Odoo & Prozessdigitalisierung (m/w/d)
description:
KODRA GmbH & Co. KG ist ein deutscher Hersteller von Hygienesystemen für Krankenhäuser und Pflegeeinrichtungen und Erfinder des Steckbeckenspülers. Seit über 90 Jahren entwickeln und produzieren wir thermische Desinfektionslösungen „Made in Germany“ – von Standalone-Geräten bis zu modularen Systemen für komplette Schmutzarbeitsräume.

Heute befinden wir uns in einer aktiven Transformationsphase: Wir modernisieren Prozesse, digitalisieren unsere Organisation und bauen Vertrieb, Service und IT konsequent aus. Mit klaren Management-Methoden, kurzen Entscheidungswegen und viel Gestaltungsspielraum führen wir ein traditionsreiches Unternehmen in eine skalierbare, digitale Zukunft – mit starkem Wachstum im DACH-Raum.

Odoo ist bei uns bereits im Einsatz.
Jetzt geht es darum, die letzten verbleibenden Systeme, Abläufe und Daten in ODOO zu bringen und konsequent weiterzuentwickeln: von Vertrieb, Service und Wartung über Produktion und Einkauf bis zu Kennzahlen, Reporting und Managementsteuerung.

Du arbeitest dabei eng mit der Geschäftsführung und den Fachabteilungen zusammen. Du übersetzt Anforderungen in funktionierende Prozesse, steuerst externe Partner und sorgst dafür, dass Odoo im Alltag wirklich genutzt wird.

Aufgaben

Gestalte bei KODRA die digitale Arbeitsweise eines produzierenden Mittelstandsunternehmens.

Deine Aufgaben

Odoo & Prozessdigitalisierung

  • Du entwickelst unsere Odoo-Landschaft gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen und externen Dienstleistern weiter.
  • Du analysierst bestehende Prozesse, identifizierst Medienbrüche und automatisierst sinnvolle Abläufe.
  • Du begleitest die Einführung und Optimierung der Odoo-Module für Vertrieb, Service/Wartung, Einkauf, Produktion und Reporting.
  • Du entwickelst Kennzahlen und Dashboards für die operative und strategische Steuerung.
  • Du dokumentierst Prozesse, Konfigurationen und Schnittstellen nachvollziehbar.
  • Du schulst Anwender und baust Odoo-Know-how im Unternehmen auf.

IT-Koordination & Betrieb

  • Du koordinierst externe IT- und Softwaredienstleister und stellst eine saubere Zusammenarbeit sicher.
  • Du unterstützt bei der Integration weiterer Systeme und bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer digitalen Infrastruktur.
  • Du sorgst für transparente Zuständigkeiten, IT-Dokumentation, Berechtigungsstrukturen und ein pragmatisches Monitoring.
  • Du bist Ansprechpartner für komplexere Anwenderfragen; der operative Standard-Support soll dabei nicht den Schwerpunkt Deiner Rolle bilden.

Dein Profil

  • Erfahrung mit Odoo – idealerweise in der Einführung, Weiterentwicklung oder im Betrieb eines mittelständischen Unternehmens.
  • Verständnis für kaufmännische und operative Prozesse, vorzugsweise in Produktion, Service oder technischem B2B-Umfeld.
  • Du kannst Anforderungen aus den Fachbereichen strukturieren und in umsetzbare Lösungen übersetzen.
  • Erfahrung in der Steuerung externer Dienstleister und in der Koordination von IT-/Digitalisierungsprojekten.
  • Du arbeitest eigenständig, pragmatisch und verbindlich.
  • Du möchtest nicht nur administrieren, sondern eine digitale Unternehmensplattform sichtbar mit aufbauen.

Was Dich erwartet

  • Eine Schlüsselrolle in der weiteren Digitalisierung von KODRA.
  • Direkter Zugang zu den Entscheidern und kurze Umsetzungswege.
  • Die Möglichkeit, Prozesse und Systeme von Grund auf nachhaltig zu gestalten.
  • Ein mittelständisches, technisch geprägtes Unternehmen mit klarer Wachstumsambition.

Qualifikation

Idealerweise bringst du mit:

description:
xHeron is building the Service-as-Software company for short-term rental operators. We own the outcome, the responsibility, and the industry standards. Traditionally, operators had two options: build and manage an internal 24/7 operation or hand over the business to a full-service property manager. We take on the operating scope directly, serving the most critical part of any hospitality business at scale: Guest Operations.

We bootstrapped to high six figures ARR in 18 months, across 500+ units, and have just closed our Pre-Seed. We're setting out to define the new standard for how short-term rental operators run their business.

Tasks

The Role

You'll be xHeron's first content and brand hire, working directly with both Founders. Your mission: be the creative genius behind xHeron and build the scalable content engine.

This isn't a role where you inherit a content calendar. You'll come up with your own creative schedule, shoot and edit your own creatives, publish, and iterate fast on what actually works, mixing founder-led content with content that's entirely your own. You'll be critical to xHeron's brand and market presence.

There's no ceiling on this. Prove the motion, and you decide what's next: Head of Content, Head of Brand, Head of Growth. Where you are in 12 months is up to you.

What You'll Own

  • Creative direction & production: Own the full creative process across formats (video, written, social), from concept through production and posting, across founder-led and original content.
  • Content engine & systems: Build your own publishing cadence, tools, and workflow, one that's scalable enough to run beyond DACH.
  • Performance & iteration: Track what's actually landing, kill what doesn't work, and double down on what does.

Requirements

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • You're entrepreneurial: you operate like a founder, figuring things out and creating your own path.
  • You have real creative range: you can write a hook that stops the scroll, shoot and edit a video, and design a graphic, without waiting on someone else to do it for you.
  • You've grown an audience or a brand's organic presence before, yours, a founder's, or a company's, and can show the receipts.
  • You have taste and humour: you know what's boring, what's good, and what will actually travel.
  • You're a native German speaker.

You May Not Be a Great Fit If

  • You want a content calendar and strategy handed to you rather than building them.
  • You only want the "strategic" parts and skip the actual writing and editing.

  • You're not interested in transitioning into a leadership role.
  • You're looking for a defined 9-to-5.

Benefits

Why Join xHeron

  • Real ownership: you're not running someone else's process, you're building the content engine.
  • Direct founder access: you'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with both Founders, with visibility into the entire business.
  • We invest in our own: we'd rather promote you into that leadership role than hire someone more senior over you later.

Our Process

  • Intro call (30 min): a conversation with Cedric about your background, what you've created, and why this role.
  • Take-home case study: a short creative brief that mirrors the kind of work you'd actually be making here.
  • Case study interview (1 hour): you walk us through your thinking, not just the final output.
  • Culture fit (30 min): meet both Founders and make sure it's a fit both ways.

title: Technical Product Owner (m/w/d)
description:
Das sind wir

An mehreren Standorten in Europa arbeiten unsere Teams täglich daran, Versandprozesse nachhaltig zu vereinfachen. Wir setzen auf offene Zusammenarbeit sowie kurze Entscheidungswege und suchen Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, Ideen einbringen und aktiv mitgestalten möchten.

Deine Rolle

Als (Technical) Product Owner (m/w/d) bist du Teil unseres Product Teams und übernimmst Verantwortung für zentrale technische Schnittstellen und Integrationen unserer Plattformen. Dein Fokus liegt insbesondere auf unseren Customer APIs, der Unified Carrier Interface (UCI) sowie perspektivisch der Unified Financial Platform (UFP) und unserer HubSpot-Integration.

Dabei bewegst du dich an der Schnittstelle zwischen Product, Engineering und Business. Du verstehst technische Zusammenhänge, übersetzt unterschiedliche Anforderungen in klare Prioritäten und sorgst gemeinsam mit unseren Teams dafür, dass unsere Integrationen zuverlässig funktionieren und sich kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln.

Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Product Ownern, unserem Technical Business Analyst, Software Engineers und Data Insights zusammen und bist gleichzeitig wichtige Ansprechperson für interne Stakeholder, Kunden, Carrier und externe Partner.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für die Roadmap unserer Customer APIs für LMS Enterprise und LMS Next und entwickelst diese strategisch weiter.

  • Du verantwortest gemeinsam mit internen und externen Stakeholdern die Weiterentwicklung unserer Unified Carrier Interface (UCI).
  • Du analysierst Anforderungen an Carrier-Features und Services, bereitest diese für unser Engineering auf und unterstützt QA bei der Definition relevanter Test Cases.
  • Du stehst im direkten Austausch mit unseren Carriern und klärst technische Anforderungen und Besonderheiten rund um deren Integrationen.
  • Nach dem Go-live übernimmst du die Verantwortung für unsere Unified Financial Platform (UFP) und steuerst deren Backlog und Weiterentwicklung.
  • Du behältst unsere bestehende HubSpot-Integration im Blick und priorisierst Anpassungen entsprechend neuer Business-Anforderungen und Feedbacks.
  • Über alle Themen hinweg bringst du Engineering, Business Stakeholder, Carrier und externe Partner zusammen und sorgst für klare Anforderungen, Prioritäten und Entscheidungen.

Das bringst du mit

  • Du verfügst über einen technischen Hintergrund, beispielsweise in Software Engineering oder Informatik, oder hast bereits mehrere Jahre an der Schnittstelle zwischen Product und Engineering gearbeitet.
  • Du bringst Erfahrung als Product Owner oder Product Manager mit – idealerweise im Umfeld von APIs, Plattformen oder technischen Integrationen.
  • Du hast ein gutes Verständnis von APIs, API Design, Versionierung und Migrationsstrategien und kannst technische Diskussionen mit unseren Engineers auf Augenhöhe führen.
  • Du kannst komplexe technische Zusammenhänge verstehen und sie für unterschiedliche Stakeholder verständlich übersetzen.
  • Du bist sicher im Stakeholder Management und kannst unterschiedliche technische und wirtschaftliche Anforderungen gegeneinander abwägen und priorisieren.
  • Mehrere parallele Workstreams und wechselnde Prioritäten bringen dich nicht aus dem Konzept – du behältst den Überblick und setzt klare Schwerpunkte.
  • Du arbeitest gerne kollaborativ und standortübergreifend mit Kollegen in Hamburg und Naarden zusammen.
  • Du interessierst dich für AI Tools und digitale Lösungen und probierst gerne neue Wege aus, um Prozesse und Workflows effizienter zu gestalten.
  • Erfahrung in Logistik, Parcel oder Freight Tech, insbesondere mit Carrier-API-Integrationen, ist ein Plus.
  • Kenntnisse rund um HubSpot bzw. CRM-Integrationen oder Finanz- und Invoicing Systeme sind ebenfalls von Vorteil.

Warum ITA Logistics Group?

Bei uns erwartet dich ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem neue Ideen ausdrücklich willkommen sind und Feedback nicht nur erlaubt, sondern erwünscht ist. Wir hinterfragen Bestehendes, arbeiten agil und entwickeln uns kontinuierlich weiter. Dazu gehört für uns auch der Einsatz moderner digitaler Tools und KI-Anwendungen, die deinen Arbeitsalltag sinnvoll unterstützen und Prozesse effizienter machen.

Grow the channel

You will personally identify, sign, and activate referral and channel partners that convert into qualified pipeline at scale. You will own the commercial relationship, including negotiation, pricing, activation, and scope expansion. Once a referred client is live, day-to-day delivery sits with the relevant operations owner; your focus stays on growing the relationship and driving more pipeline through it.

Close the capability map

You will identify, structure, and maintain relationships with specialist and regulated providers that allow bunch to service fund mandates end-to-end. These relationships are ongoing and operational by nature; you own them commercially while delivery runs alongside the relevant teams.

title: Deal Desk Senior Manager
description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including On Running, Breitling, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.


About the Role

This is a rare opportunity to build a truly strategic Deal Desk function at Perk — one that shapes how our Sales organisation structures, prices, and closes its most complex, high-value deals. We're investing in this transformation now, and we want a leader who can turn that ambition into reality.

We're hiring a Senior Deal Desk Manager to lead this shift. You'll take ownership of the Deal Desk team and its transformation, personally running point on our most complex and strategic deals while building a team that operates as trusted commercial partners to Sales, Finance, and Legal. A major part of the role will be modernising how the team works: automating manual processes through AI and automation, and improving our CPQ and quoting systems so Sales can move faster with confidence.

This is a coach-player role: you'll lead and develop a team while staying hands-on with the deals that matter most.


What You'll Do

Lead the transformation

  • Rebuild Deal Desk's operating model so the team spends its time on complex deal structuring and pricing strategy for high-value opportunities, not manual admin like company setup or payment profile processing — and put in place the triage, tools, and ways of working that make that shift stick.

  • Decide what Deal Desk should own, support, automate, or hand off to other teams, and build the case for change with Legal, Finance, and Sales Operations leadership.

  • Agree clear ownership and service levels for work that moves to other teams (for example, NDAs, supplier and financial forms, payment term changes, and downgrade/churn processing), so handovers actually stick.

  • Build performance metrics and reporting to track deal velocity, team output, and the impact of process and automation improvements over time.

  • Represent Deal Desk as a trusted, credible partner in cross-functional forums and with Sales leadership.

Lead the team and run point on complex deals

  • Build, lead, and develop a team of Deal Desk professionals, setting clear goals and performance standards as the team matures into a more strategic function.

  • Act as a coach-player: personally run point on Perk's most complex, highest-value deals, modelling the standard of deal structuring, negotiation support, and stakeholder management expected of the team.

  • Own pricing governance and deal structuring for complex, non-standard commercial deals, balancing commercial risk with deal velocity.

  • Mentor the team on complex deal structuring, pricing strategy, and commercial risk judgement, and coach them through escalations.

  • Partner with Legal, Finance, Sales Operations, and Product to unblock deals and resolve cross-functional friction quickly.

Own our systems and quoting experience

  • Own the relationship with our CPQ platform end to end, bringing prior experience owning a complex CPQ implementation elsewhere.

  • Identify and drive improvements to CPQ configuration, pricing logic, and quoting workflows so Sales can quote and close faster with confidence.

  • Act as the primary Deal Desk voice in Revenue Systems and CPQ/CLM tooling roadmap decisions.

Drive automation and AI

  • Own the automation roadmap for Deal Desk, with a clear mandate to remove manual, repetitive work from the team through AI and automation.

  • Prioritise and deliver automation of the highest-impact manual workflows first, such as company and payment profile setup and post-signature subscription provisioning, which today account for a significant share of the team's ticket volume.

  • Partner with engineering/systems teams to scope, sequence, and deliver automation initiatives, and track the time saved and volume shifted off manual processing.

  • Evaluate and pilot AI tools for use cases such as contract redline review, NDA triage, and deal risk flagging, working closely with Legal.

Protect the business

  • Act as Deal Desk's first line of defense on contract redlines and non-standard deal terms, escalating to Legal or Finance where needed.

  • Own commercial governance frameworks, pricing and discounting policy, and approval structures across the function.

  • Safeguard deal commercials, business risk, and revenue recognition implications on complex and non-standard deals.


What We're Looking For

  • Strong Deal Desk experience within B2B SaaS, ideally spanning mid-market and enterprise segments.

  • Proven experience leading a Deal Desk (or equivalent commercial/sales operations) team, with direct people management responsibility.

  • A genuine coach-player: comfortable personally running complex, high-value deals while simultaneously leading and developing a team.

  • Prior ownership of a complex CPQ platform, with a track record of driving measurable improvements to quoting, pricing, and deal velocity for Sales.

  • Experience scoping and delivering automation and/or AI initiatives that reduce manual operational work, ideally in partnership with engineering or systems teams.

  • Strong cross-functional stakeholder management skills, comfortable partnering across Legal, Finance, Sales Operations, and Product.

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-changing, ambiguous environment where processes are still being defined and improved.


What We Offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk.

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays.

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex.

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva.

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen.

  • Rest assured that you're covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence.

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus.

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party.

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones.

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks' paid parental leave.

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes.

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year.

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards.

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years.

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support.

AI at Perk

AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled, so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

We don't expect you to be an AI expert, but we do expect you to be curious and intentional about it. The bar is judgment: knowing when AI makes your work better, when to verify what it produces, and when to rely on your own expertise instead.

We'll ask about how you use AI in your interviews, not to test tool knowledge, but to understand how you think about it. That reflects how we work every day.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

title: Strategic Finance Manager
description:
Strategic Finance Manager — The Flex

The Flex is creating the future of flexible accommodation.

We operate and manage properties across multiple cities and countries, bringing together hospitality, technology and operational excellence to make renting a home as effortless as booking a hotel.

As our international footprint expands, we are searching for an outstanding Strategic Finance Manager to help build the financial systems, controls and insights required to support a rapidly growing global business.

This is far more than a conventional accounting position. You will work closely with our founders and leadership team, take ownership of essential financial processes, evaluate business performance and provide the insights that enable better decisions as we scale.

Your Mission

As Strategic Finance Manager, you will play a central role in The Flex’s financial operations.

Your objective will be to give the business complete clarity over where its revenue comes from, how its money is spent, how each area is performing and where profitability can be improved.

Your responsibilities will span accounting, financial analysis, management reporting, payment reconciliation, budgeting and business performance.

You will have exposure to the entire organisation, collaborating directly with operations, revenue management, property teams and senior leadership.

For an ambitious individual, this position offers a clear path toward becoming Head of Finance or, ultimately, moving into a CFO-track role as The Flex continues to grow.

What You Will Own

  • Lead and continuously strengthen our day-to-day financial controls and reporting, ensuring that every number shared with management is accurate, validated, complete and supported by reliable evidence.

  • Identify repetitive and manual finance tasks, create more efficient processes and collaborate with our engineering teams to automate them.

  • Reconcile payments from Airbnb, Booking.com, Expedia, direct reservations and other distribution partners, confirming that every expected payment is received correctly and on schedule.

  • Reconcile bank accounts and incoming transactions, ensuring that funds are properly received and recorded while investigating and resolving discrepancies quickly.

  • Monitor and manage accounts payable and accounts receivable.

  • Review supplier invoices and expenses incurred across the company.

  • Oversee statutory filings and corporate compliance requirements across several jurisdictions, making sure that all submissions are correct and completed within the required deadlines.

  • Coordinate with external accountants, tax advisers, auditors and banking partners to maintain accurate financial records and ensure timely compliance.

  • Assist with financial statements for landlords and property owners whenever required.

  • Develop dashboards and reporting tools that provide management with real-time visibility into company performance.

  • Evaluate financial results across individual properties, cities, countries and business units.

  • Create and maintain company budgets, forecasts and financial models.

  • Track cash flow and support management in planning future funding and capital needs.

  • Detect financial risks, discrepancies and potential sources of revenue leakage.

  • Review the company’s cost base and uncover opportunities to strengthen margins.

  • Partner with operational teams to understand, control and reduce costs at property level.

  • Contribute to financial due diligence for acquisitions, investments and expansion into new markets.

  • Communicate financial findings, recommendations and actionable insights directly to the founders and management team.

What We Are Looking For

  • A highly analytical individual who is confident and comfortable working with numbers.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and an uncompromising approach to financial accuracy.

  • A strong understanding of accounting concepts and financial principles.

  • The ability to work effectively with significant volumes of financial and operational data.

  • Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets.

  • Strong capabilities in financial reconciliation, controls and problem-solving.

  • A commercial mindset—you do more than report figures; you understand their meaning and implications for the wider business.

  • A strong sense of ownership, responsibility and accountability.

  • The confidence to work independently, find solutions and navigate unfamiliar challenges.

  • The ability to perform in a fast-paced environment where priorities may evolve quickly.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

  • The confidence to communicate and work directly with senior management.

  • A genuine interest in technology, automation and AI, together with the ability to identify opportunities to improve and automate finance processes.

  • The ambition to grow quickly and assume substantially greater responsibility over time.

  • Experience in accounting, audit, investment banking, private equity, FP&A, consulting, hospitality, real estate or a high-growth startup would be highly valuable.

  • A degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, Mathematics or another analytical discipline is preferred, although exceptional applicants from other backgrounds are encouraged to apply.

What Success Will Look Like

During your first 6–12 months, you will have:

  • Developed a detailed understanding of the financial performance of every major area of The Flex.

  • Established dependable monthly management reporting across the company.

  • Ensured that payments from booking platforms and commercial partners are fully reconciled and that all expected funds are received.

  • Significantly improved visibility into cash flow, profitability and unit economics.

  • Uncovered meaningful opportunities to lower costs and improve margins.

  • Automated several finance processes that were previously completed manually.

  • Established yourself as a trusted financial partner to the founders and management team.

  • Taken responsibility for increasingly important areas of the company’s finance function.

Why Join The Flex?

  • Become part of a rapidly growing international business operating at the intersection of real estate, hospitality and technology.

  • Work closely and directly with the company’s founders and senior leaders.

  • Gain hands-on exposure to the financial operations of a business spanning multiple countries.

  • Influence profitability and contribute directly to major strategic and commercial decisions.

  • Help design and build the finance function instead of simply taking over an established set of processes.

  • Apply technology and AI to reimagine how a modern finance function should operate.

  • Take meaningful ownership and responsibility from your first day.

  • Receive a competitive salary together with performance-based incentives.

  • Benefit from exceptional long-term career progression as The Flex continues its international expansion.

You Should Not Apply If

  • You want a conventional corporate 9-to-5 position with limited and narrowly defined responsibilities.

  • You rely on someone else to continuously tell you what needs to be done.

  • You are uncomfortable taking responsibility and being accountable for the quality of your work.

  • You would rather report financial figures than understand, challenge and improve them.

  • You engage in workplace politics, gossip or conversations about colleagues behind their backs.

  • You are searching for a slow-moving, predictable role with limited career progression.

  • You do not aspire to become one of the very best in the world at what you do.

Enterprises don't struggle to access AI capability; they struggle to deploy it. Your job is closing that gap for a small portfolio of monday.com's highest-value customers. You will advise executives on AI-driven operational change, design and ship the systems that make it real, and feed what you learn back into the product with evidence, not anecdotes.

You will work with: monday AI agents, MCP-based integrations into customer systems, vibe apps, and production workflows. You will take these from discovery through architecture, build, rollout, and measurable adoption.

Cross-functional leadership. Partner with Sales and CS as the technical authority on account strategy. Productize what you learn: patterns, agents, and assets from one account become reusable machinery for the whole motion.

title: Principal Thermo-Mechanical Engineer- Paris/Grenoble
description:
About Us

We are building Physics AI for hardware design. Our software platform helps hardware designers and physics simulation engineers explore, analyze, and optimize hardware systems, leveraging cutting-edge AI to deliver ultrafast, accurate physics intelligence within the realities of engineering design workflows.

Our first product bridges the gap between the accuracy & determinism of traditional simulation and the speed & scaling of AI, and is redefining how the world’s most advanced semiconductors are designed, verified, built, brought to market and integrated in complex systems.

Role Overview

As a pivotal leader within our European Forward Deployment team, you will drive the adoption of Vinci’s platform among the region's top engineering organizations. In this strategic role, you will build, mentor, and guide a high-performing team of thermal engineers dedicated to engaging prospective customers and demonstrating our software's transformative value.

As trusted technical advisors, you and your team will use deep simulation expertise to help enterprise customers validate and optimize complex, real-world designs. Through these collaborative engagements, you will champion Vinci's value proposition by showing how our platform delivers systemic improvements in thermal performance, product reliability, and time-to-market.

Leveraging strong fundamentals in continuum mechanics, you will guide analyses of complex physical phenomena, including linear, geometric and material nonlinearities, and contact interactions. Your team will evaluate critical factors such as warpage, stress evolution, thermal cycling, and reliability across advanced semiconductor devices, electronics packages, and wafer-scale systems.

You will work closely with customer engineering teams to understand their technical challenges, provide expert guidance, and clearly articulate Vinci’s capabilities in solving real-world problems. You will also serve as a key feedback channel to product and engineering teams, translating customer insights into actionable inputs that shape product direction and drive continuous improvement.

This is a remote role, with close collaboration with Sales, Product, and Engineering in Palo Alto, CA, USA. The role includes moderate travel, primarily within continental Europe. Some infrequent intercontinental travel may be required for discussions and collaboration with the US team.

Responsibilities

  • Build, lead, and scale a high-performing team of thermo-mechanical engineers, setting the technical direction, hiring, mentoring team members, and driving field execution across Europe.

  • Collaborate closely with the sales team to lead technical discussions, scope proof-of-concept (PoC) evaluations, and deliver compelling product demonstrations to prospective enterprise customers.

  • Guide customer engineering teams through the evaluation phase by overseeing simulation setup, running complex test cases, and interpreting results to explicitly prove Vinci’s technical and business value.

  • Own customer enablement through onboarding, deployment pipeline and account expansion, providing senior technical guidance, structured training sessions, and advanced troubleshooting.

  • Provide product guidance and feedback, identify customer pain points and workflow bottlenecks, partnering directly with internal product and engineering teams to transform field feedback into critical new product features.

  • Represent Vinci at major industry conferences and semiconductor events, engaging technically with key prospects and partners through technical presentations and live platform demonstrations.

  • Maintain a strong understanding of competitive technologies, industry trends, and market positioning to communicate Vinci’s differentiators effectively.

Qualifications (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Education: Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related technical field.

  • Technical depth: Expert-level mastery of commercial simulation software (Asys, Abaqus, or equivalent), with 15+ years of hands-on experience in thermo-mechanical simulations— either as a practitioner running simulations or as a technical account manager for commercial physics simulation software.

  • Industry Domain: Deep familiarity with semiconductor electronics packaging, advanced packaging technologies (e.g., 2.5D/3D IC), or foundry ecosystems.

  • Customer Engagement: Prior experience in dedicated customer-facing roles, with a strong ability to build trust and manage engineering client relationships.

  • Automation & Scripting: Practical programming experience using Python or C++ to automate workflows or parse simulation data.

  • Leadership Impact: Proven track record of prior managerial or technical leadership experience, with the ability to scale, mentor, and drive execution across engineering teams.

  • Communication: Elite interpersonal and communication skills, with a proven ability to distill complex physics and simulation results into clear, high-impact narratives for both deep technical panels and business-oriented executives.

Preferred (Desirable Differentiators)

  • Multiphysics Breadth: Familiarity with thermal solutions management and/or Electrical Signal Integrity and Power Integrity (SI/PI) workflows.

  • Commercial Track Record: Direct experience commercializing technical software—ideally electronic design automation (EDA) or CAE simulation tools—into major semiconductor and electronics enterprises.

  • Go-To-Market Experience: Prior experience explicitly within technical pre-sales, application engineering (FAE), or strategic technical sales environments.

  • Emerging Tech Adjacency: Ability to rapidly adopt and champion next-generation, physics-based workflows and AI-assisted design or simulation tools.

Why Join Us

  • Not just use AI; be part of a team actively redefining how next-generation silicon and hardware are architected.

  • Work at the absolute convergence of state-of-the-art AI models, fundamental physics, and high-stakes enterprise

  • Collaborate with world-class engineers and researchers in a fast-moving startup environment.Ingénieur / Ingénieure principal/e en thermomécanique (H/F) — Paris/Grenoble

    À propos de Vinci

    Vinci développe une IA fondée sur la physique (Physics AI) pour la conception de systèmes hardware. Notre plateforme donne aux équipes de conception et de simulation des prédictions physiques précises, obtenues en une fraction du temps d'une simulation classique, et qui s'intègrent à leurs outils existants.

    C'est la première solution à offrir à la fois la rigueur de la simulation traditionnelle et la vitesse de l'IA. Elle transforme la façon dont les semi-conducteurs les plus avancés au monde sont conçus, vérifiés, fabriqués, mis sur le marché et intégrés dans des systèmes complexes.

    Présentation du poste

    En tant que membre clé de notre équipe européenne de Forward Deployment, vous jouerez un rôle déterminant dans l'adoption de la plateforme Vinci par les principales organisations d'ingénierie de la région. Dans ce rôle stratégique, vous constituerez, accompagnerez et dirigerez une équipe performante de spécialistes en ingénierie thermique, chargée d'accompagner nos clients et prospects et de démontrer concrètement la valeur de notre logiciel.

    En tant que référent technique de confiance auprès de nos clients, vous et votre équipe mettrez à profit votre expertise approfondie en simulation pour aider nos clients industriels à valider et optimiser des conceptions complexes dans des conditions représentatives de leurs applications réelles. À travers ces collaborations, vous démontrerez comment la plateforme Vinci permet d'améliorer les performances thermiques et la fiabilité des produits, tout en accélérant les cycles de conception et la mise sur le marché.

    Grâce à votre solide maîtrise de la mécanique des milieux continus, vous guiderez l'analyse de phénomènes physiques complexes : comportements linéaires, non-linéarités géométriques et matérielles, et interactions de contact. Votre équipe aidera les clients à évaluer des paramètres critiques tels que le warpage, l'évolution des contraintes, le cyclage thermique et la fiabilité, sur des composants semi-conducteurs avancés, des packages électroniques et des systèmes à l'échelle du wafer.

    Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d'ingénierie de nos clients afin de comprendre leurs problématiques techniques, de leur apporter une expertise approfondie et de démontrer clairement comment Vinci peut répondre à leurs cas d'usage concrets. Vous jouerez également un rôle essentiel d'interface entre les clients et nos équipes Product et Engineering, en transformant les retours du terrain en informations exploitables pour orienter la feuille de route produit et contribuer à l'amélioration continue de la plateforme.

    Ce poste est basé en France et exercé en télétravail, avec une collaboration étroite avec les équipes Sales, Product et Engineering basées à Palo Alto, en Californie. Il implique des déplacements réguliers mais modérés, principalement en Europe continentale, ainsi que des déplacements occasionnels aux États-Unis pour collaborer avec l'équipe américaine.

    Responsabilités

    • Construire, diriger et développer une équipe performante d'ingénieur/es en thermomécanique, en définissant l'orientation technique, en recrutant et accompagnant les membres de l'équipe, et en pilotant l'exécution sur le terrain à travers l'Europe.

    • Collaborer étroitement avec l'équipe Sales pour diriger les discussions techniques, définir le périmètre des évaluations en proof-of-concept (PoC) et réaliser des démonstrations de produits convaincantes auprès de clients industriels potentiels.

    • Accompagner les équipes d'ingénierie des clients pendant la phase d'évaluation en supervisant la mise en place des simulations, l'exécution de cas de test complexes et l'interprétation des résultats afin de démontrer concrètement la valeur technique et business de Vinci.

    • Piloter l'accompagnement technique des clients, notamment l'onboarding, le déploiement et l'expansion des comptes, en fournissant une expertise technique de haut niveau, des sessions de formation structurées et un support avancé pour la résolution des problèmes.

    • Fournir des orientations et des retours sur le produit, identifier les difficultés rencontrées par les clients et les points de friction dans leurs workflows, et collaborer directement avec les équipes Produit et Engineering internes afin de transformer les retours du terrain en fonctionnalités produit clés.

    • Représenter Vinci lors de grandes conférences industrielles et d'événements dédiés aux semi-conducteurs, en échangeant avec des prospects et partenaires stratégiques à travers des présentations techniques et des démonstrations en direct de la plateforme.

    • Maintenir une excellente compréhension des technologies concurrentes, des tendances du secteur et du positionnement du marché afin de communiquer efficacement les éléments différenciants de Vinci.

    Qualifications (Qualifications minimales)

    Formation : Diplôme d'ingénieur ou équivalent (Master, doctorat) en génie mécanique, génie électrique ou dans un domaine technique étroitement lié.

    Expertise technique : Maîtrise approfondie de logiciels de simulation commerciaux (Ansys, Abaqus ou équivalent), avec plus de 15 ans d'expérience pratique en simulation thermomécanique — que ce soit en réalisant vous-même des simulations ou dans une fonction de Technical Account Manager pour des logiciels commerciaux de simulation physique.

    Domaine industriel : Solide connaissance des technologies de packaging électronique pour les semi-conducteurs, des technologies de packaging avancé (par exemple, IC 2.5D/3D) ou des écosystèmes de fonderies.

    Relation client : Expérience préalable dans des fonctions directement orientées client, avec une forte capacité à établir une relation de confiance et à gérer des relations avec des équipes d'ingénierie côté client.

    Automatisation & scripting : Expérience pratique en programmation avec Python ou C++ pour automatiser des flux de travail ou analyser des données issues de simulations.

    Leadership : Expérience avérée en management ou en leadership technique, avec la capacité à développer une équipe, accompagner ses membres et piloter l'exécution au sein d'équipes d'ingénierie.

    Communication : Excellentes compétences interpersonnelles et de communication, avec une capacité démontrée à transformer des résultats complexes de physique et de simulation en messages clairs et à fort impact, aussi bien pour des publics techniques de haut niveau que pour des directions non spécialistes.

    Profil recherché (Atouts différenciants)

    Expertise multiphysique : Connaissance de la gestion thermique et des solutions de refroidissement et/ou des flux de travail Signal Integrity et Power Integrity (SI/PI).

    Expérience commerciale : Expérience directe dans la commercialisation de logiciels techniques — idéalement des outils d'Electronic Design Automation (EDA) ou de simulation CAE — auprès de grandes entreprises des secteurs des semi-conducteurs et de l'électronique.

    Parcours Go-to-Market : Passage préalable par des fonctions de pré-vente technique, d'ingénierie applicative (FAE) ou de vente technique stratégique.

    Technologies émergentes : Capacité à adopter rapidement et à promouvoir des flux de travail de nouvelle génération fondés sur la physique, ainsi que des outils de conception ou de simulation assistés par l'IA.

    Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

    • Ne vous contentez pas d'utiliser l'IA : rejoignez une équipe qui redéfinit activement la manière dont le silicium et les systèmes hardware de nouvelle génération sont conçus.

    • Travaillez à la convergence de modèles d'IA de pointe, de la physique fondamentale et de projets industriels à forts enjeux.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
As a Forward Deployed Engineer in the customer organisation, you are the technical spearhead of monday.com's AI transformation motion for our most strategic customers. You will carry a portfolio of 1 to 2 strategic accounts, deeply embedded with C-level and technical teams to architect, build, and ship AI solutions in production, and you will be accountable for the business outcomes those engagements promised, not just the build.

This is part of a growing motion, and you will be joining a team that’s already working on active deployments.

Please note this is a hybrid position of 3 days/week in our Paris office.

About the Role

Enterprises don't struggle to access AI capability; they struggle to deploy it. Your job is closing that gap for a small portfolio of monday.com's highest-value customers. You will advise executives on AI-driven operational change, design and ship the systems that make it real, and feed what you learn back into the product with evidence, not anecdotes.

You will work with: monday AI agents, MCP-based integrations into customer systems, vibe apps, and production workflows. You will take these from discovery through architecture, build, rollout, and measurable adoption.

This is an autonomous, high-visibility role that shapes both customer outcomes and the future of forward-deployed engineering at monday.com.

What You'll Do

Strategic transformation. Embed with C-level stakeholders across your accounts to architect end-to-end AI solutions and scalable workflows that solve complex, mission-critical business pains. You own the narrative from pilot to full production rollout.

Outcome ownership. Your success metric is the business result the engagement committed to: adoption, workflow throughput, measurable ROI. You define the success criteria with the customer up front and you own getting there.

Build and ship. Design sophisticated platform configurations, build monday agents and vibe apps, wire MCP integrations into customer systems, and prototype custom scripts where the platform ends. Your leverage is architecture and judgment; your credibility is that you can build it yourself.

Eval-driven product feedback. Instrument your deployments, run evals against real customer workflows, and translate what you find into PRDs and roadmap input that changes what we build. You are a sensor for the product org, with data behind every claim.

Cross-functional leadership. Partner with Sales and CS as the technical authority on account strategy. Productize what you learn: patterns, agents, and assets from one account become reusable machinery for the whole motion.

What we promise

This role has been built with a direct line into the product roadmap, a mandate to productize rather than repeat, and outcome-based success criteria agreed before the build starts.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years building applications from scratch using TypeScript/Node.js/React, with full-stack depth

  • Experience leading hands-on projects end-to-end in a production environment, preferably client-facing

  • Background in Solution Architecture or Software Engineering with a strong grasp of AI/LLM systems: agent architectures, MCP or comparable tool-use protocols, evals, and prompt-to-production workflows

  • Experience navigating C-suite relationships and influencing executive decisions in ambiguous environments

  • Track record of turning one-off delivery work into reusable assets, product requirements, or repeatable playbooks

  • Entrepreneurial, fast-moving, and focused on long-term impact over immediate fixes

Nous recherchons aujourd’hui des talents créatifs, structurés et agiles qui partagent l’envie d’améliorer sans cesse tout ce qui peut l’être. Des talents passionnés, autonomes qui conçoivent le travail dans le respect des autres et pour qui rien n'est hors d'atteinte, pour peu qu'on s'en donne les moyens.

Envie d’imaginer la suite de cette histoire à nos côtés ? Ecrivez-nous !

Nous recherchons les talents d’un(e) futur(e) Data Scientist / Data Analyst (H/F) pour rejoindre nos équipes à l’occasion d’un stage de 6 mois de fin d’études de M2 à partir de mars 2027. Ce stage est basé à Paris (75). 

Intégré(e) au sein du pôle E-commerce et rattaché(e) au Lead Data Science & Analytics, vous accompagnerez l’équipe dans les sujets du quotidien ainsi que dans la construction de projets dédiés. Vous serez amené(e)s à travailler sur les sujets suivants :

Data Analyse

Vous serez un(e) membre à part entière de l'équipe Data Science & Analytics et participerez activement à son quotidien :

  • Analyses Ad Hoc : Vous mènerez diverses analyses ponctuelles indispensables pour affiner notre compréhension de nos marques, de la performance de nos produits et du comportement de nos client(e)s.
  • Excellence Opérationnelle : Vous contribuerez au développement continu de l'équipe en identifiant les points de friction, en structurant de nouveaux process et en automatisant les tâches récurrentes.
  • Reporting & Communication Métiers: Vous prendrez la responsabilité de plusieurs mises à jour de reportings. Vous serez responsable du maintien de dashboards hebdomadaires, de reportings mensuels, et de l'initiation des communications clés à destination des équipes métiers.
  • Accompagnement Marketing : Vous participerez aux opérations courantes en réalisant des extractions de données ciblées pour nos initiatives marketing. Cela inclut la mise en place de groupes de contrôle rigoureux et la mesure de la performance incrémentale de ces campagnes.
  • Intégration de l'IA : Vous serez amené(e) à utiliser l'IA au quotidien dans vos missions et participerez activement à la définition et au partage des bonnes pratiques quant à son utilisation au sein de l'équipe.


Mise en place d’un moteur d'Embeddings Produits (NLP) : Vous serez au cœur du développement d’un socle algorithmique clé : la transformation de descriptions textuelles en représentations vectorielles (embeddings). Ce projet nourrira de multiples initiatives futures.

Vous interviendrez sur l'ensemble du cycle de vie du projet :

  • Data Preprocessing : Nettoyage des données textuelles issues du catalogue, normalisation, et préparation des corpus d'entraînement.
  • Modélisation : Benchmark, sélection fine-tuning des modèles appropriés (Sentence-Transformers, LLMs, etc.).
  • Industrialisation : Le stage ne s’arrête pas au prototype expérimental. Vous participerez activement au déploiement du pipeline dans notre environnement de production via Metaflow.
  • Monitoring : Mise en place de l'automatisation pour la mise à jour des vecteurs lors des nouvelles collections et monitoring de la qualité des embeddings dans le temps.

Requirements

  • Vous êtes étudiant(e) en dernière année de formation supérieure (BAC+5) avec une spécialité en Data Science / Machine Learning.
  • Une maîtrise suffisante de SQL est essentielle.
  • Des connaissances en Python seront valorisées.

title: Post-doctorante ou post-doctorant en Informatique - CDD 12 Mois
description:
Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable. Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain.

Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif.

L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain.

À Mines Saint-Étienne, nos centres de recherche sont le cœur battant de notre École.

Pensés comme de véritables hubs d’innovation, nos cinq Centres de Formation et de Recherche articulent leurs expertises autour de grands enjeux industriels, environnementaux, sociétaux et technologiques.

Leur mission ? Imaginer le monde de demain en alliant excellence académique et impact concret.

Quand la technologie rencontre la médecine, ça donne… le Centre Ingénierie Santé (CIS) !

Des dispositifs médicaux innovants (biomécanique, biomatériaux, nanoparticules) aux jumeaux numériques du patient et de l’hôpital, le CIS développe des solutions sur mesure pour répondre aux enjeux actuels de la santé.

🧠 Modélisation, simulation, intelligence collective : nos enseignants-chercheurs travaillent main dans la main avec médecins, industriels et institutions.

💙 Une seule ambition : améliorer le soin et la vie des personnes grâce à la science.

🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous

En tant que post-doctorant(e), vous êtes au cœur des missions de recherche et d’innovation du Centre Ingénierie et Santé. Vous rejoignez l’équipe i4S pour développer les fondements scientifiques d’une nouvelle génération de jumeaux numériques populationnels (JNP) en santé, en lien étroit avec la société Dali.

Le Centre Ingénierie et Santé développe des recherches à l’interface entre ingénierie, mathématiques, informatique et santé. Ses travaux associent modélisation, simulation, intelligence artificielle et sciences des données pour répondre à des problématiques cliniques, organisationnelles et populationnelles en collaboration avec des acteurs académiques, hospitaliers et industriels.

Dali (Decision Aid · Live Innovation) est un bureau d’études innovant spécialisé dans la modélisation, la simulation et l’intelligence artificielle appliquées au système de santé. Son ambition est de transformer le système de soins grâce à une ingénierie de pointe basée sur des données : création de jumeaux numériques, modélisation prédictive, optimisation de parcours patients, modélisation de services hospitaliers et amélioration des performances des organisations de santé. Dali a été co-créée début 2025 par Martin PRODEL (PhD, 12 ans d’expérience en données de santé, ex-Heva) et Vincent Augusto (PhD, HDR, Pr, 20 d’expérience en ingénierie de la santé et recherche, Mines Saint-Etienne). 

Objectif stratégique : préparer les briques scientifiques des JNP à horizon 3 à 5 ans, au-delà des premiers démonstrateurs industriels déjà engagés.

 

Le post-doctorat doit permettre de lever des verrous en modélisation dynamique de cohortes, génération de patients virtuels, apprentissage des transitions et simulation de scénarios contrefactuels.

 

Vos missions principales :

  • Vous concevez et formalisez des modèles mathématiques et stochastiques de trajectoires de patients : chaînes de Markov, modèles multi-états, modèles d’état, processus de décision markoviens, simulation Monte-Carlo et approches hybrides.

  • Vous développez en Python des prototypes de JNP capables d’apprendre leurs paramètres à partir de données réelles, de générer des trajectoires virtuelles et de tester des scénarios thérapeutiques ou de prise en charge.

  • Vous proposez des méthodes de calibration, d’estimation, d’optimisation, de quantification de l’incertitude et de validation des modèles ; vous comparez les approches sur des cas d’usage issus de cohortes, registres ou données de vie réelle.

  • Vous contribuez à la valorisation scientifique des travaux (publications, conférences, logiciels), à la formalisation des briques transférables vers DALI et vous rendez compte de l’avancement au responsable scientifique du projet.

 

Votre capacité à passer d’un problème scientifique à un modèle formel puis à une implémentation robuste sera essentielle. Le poste demande un goût prononcé pour les mathématiques appliquées, l’algorithmique, la programmation scientifique et la recherche interdisciplinaire.


🔍 Ce que nous recherchons

Vous êtes impérativement titulaire d’un :

  • Doctorat (Bac + 8) en mathématiques appliquées, informatique, automatique, recherche opérationnelle, génie industriel, data science quantitative ou domaine proche.

Profil scientifique recherché :

  • Solide formation en probabilités, statistiques, processus stochastiques, optimisation, modélisation et simulation, et/ou systèmes dynamiques.

  • Appétence pour le domaine de la santé.

Compétences attendues :

  • Maîtrise avancée de Python scientifique (NumPy, pandas, SciPy, scikit-learn ou équivalents) et bonnes pratiques de développement logiciel, versionnement et reproductibilité.

  • Expérience significative d’au moins une famille de modèles dynamiques : Markov / MDP, modèles multi-états, Monte-Carlo, équations différentielles, modèles d’état ou simulation multi-agents / à événements discrets.

  • Capacité à articuler modèles mathématiques et données : estimation de paramètres, calibration, analyse de sensibilité, validation, quantification de l’incertitude.

  • Maîtrise de l’anglais scientifique écrit et oral (niveau B2 minimum, C1 apprécié) ; capacité à rédiger des articles et à présenter des travaux dans un contexte international.

Vos atouts supplémentaires :

  • Expérience sur données longitudinales, données de santé, cohortes, essais cliniques ou données de vie réelle.

  • Connaissance d’un environnement de simulation (AnyLogic, SimPy, MATLAB/Simulink ou équivalent) et/ou d’un langage compilé (C++, Java).

  • Expérience de publication dans des revues ou conférences en modélisation, simulation, intelligence artificielle, recherche opérationnelle ou santé numérique.

🌍 Pourquoi rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne ?

Nous accompagnons chacun de nos collaborateurs sur le chemin de l’excellence, avec la conviction qu’ensemble, nous pouvons avoir un impact durable et significatif sur notre monde.

Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est l’opportunité de trouver :

· Un environnement stimulant : des moyens expérimentaux de pointe, un réseau international solide (T.I.M.E., EULIST) et des campus à taille humaine avec un environnement urbain

· Un impact réel : des projets de recherche contractuelle à hauteur de 11 M€/an, majoritairement avec des partenaires industriels, un centre de culture scientifique la Rotonde qui s’engage depuis 25 ans dans la médiation des sciences avec plus de 50 000 visiteurs/an

Construisons un avenir plus durable, à travers la science, l’ingénierie, et des projets qui font sens.
